messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] a question about how to apply the function FrangmentLengthNormalization on my own data
parts:
Hi,

no there is no simple way to import log-ratios. Also, the
FrangmentLengthNormalization is operating on the chip effects and not
the log-ratios (of such), cf. our paper Bengtsson H et al. 2008 (see
group page). This is slightly different from the ideas implemented in
CNAG, which operates on log-ratios. It is not that hard to manually
fit and correct for deviations in (l_j, M_ij), using say loess() or
smooth.spline() in R, where fragment lengths l_j and log-ratios M_ij
for loci j=1,...,J per sample i.

Cheers

/Henrik
